description: Railway usage is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This dataset contains information relating to the usage of railway and is sourced from the Office of Road and Rail. It is based upon counts of people entering and leaving Leicester railway station. Data is updated yearly. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are railway. The portal shows 6 records. The portal shows 2025-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
